title: Perturbative construction of amplitudes from on-shell trees with vacuum pairs: the all-plus four-gluon amplitude through order $g^6$
summary: We formulate a systematic on-shell construction of perturbative amplitudes by combining the Feynman-tree theorem with BCFW recursion. Amplitudes are built entirely from on-shell tree amplitudes generated by BCFW and are supplemented by additional unobservable state-conjugate on-shell pairs, called vacuum pairs, whose momenta are integrated over Lorentz-invariant phase space. At fixed coupling order, the contributing tree amplitudes are classified by polygon bookkeeping, while their products form forests whose relative signs are fixed by inclusion-exclusion.
